scope: Bounded primary-source screen, not an exhaustive novelty or venue review

sources.title: Foundations of Assumption-based Truth Maintenance Systems: Preliminary Report
sources.authors: Raymond Reiter and Johan de Kleer
sources.relevance: Justifications and support contexts are established; flat parent exhaustion is not a general AND/OR justification model.

sources.title: Maintaining Views Incrementally
sources.authors: Ashish Gupta, Inderpal Singh Mumick and V. S. Subrahmanian
sources.relevance: Counting and delete/rederive methods maintain derived relations after changes, including recursive views.

sources.title: Provenance Semirings
sources.authors: Todd J. Green, Grigoris Karvounarakis and Val Tannen
sources.relevance: Relational and Datalog provenance have algebraic treatments; one path does not describe every derivation.

sources.title: Trusty URIs: Verifiable, Immutable, and Permanent Digital Artifacts for Linked Data
sources.relevance: Hash-addressed, verifiable reference trees predate this POC; hashes alone are not a novelty claim.

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.relevance: W3C provenance invalidation is entity cessation/expiry/destruction; it is not automatically logical falsity or ket support exhaustion.

sources.title: Self-correction in science: The effect of retraction on the frequency of citations
sources.authors: Anton Kühberger, Daniel Streit and Thomas Scherndl
sources.relevance: A primary empirical comparison using matched controls and temporal analyses; current selected cohort supports neither causal nor population claims.

sources.title: OpenAlex data license
sources.relevance: OpenAlex metadata is CC0; retain source/snapshot attribution and distinguish metadata from linked content.

sources.title: Crossref Metadata Retrieval: Licensing
sources.relevance: Bibliographic/RW metadata and publisher/author-owned abstracts have different reuse treatment; two abstract fields remain in the frozen POC.

sources.title: ACM Artifact Review and Badging, version 1.1
sources.relevance: Artifact availability/evaluation and independent validation of results are distinct. Internal agent checks confer no external badge.
sources.access_note: Canonical URL and full mirror fetch returned HTTP403 during this screen; search-extracted ACM policy text and official SIGIR guidance were available. Recheck current venue requirements before submission.
